WITH ranked AS (

        ss."numge1500"::numeric / NULLIF(ss."numtsttakr", 0) AS excellence_rate

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname1") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname2") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname3") <> ''
),

name_counts AS (
    SELECT "first_name", COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "first_name"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 2
)

SELECT nc."first_name", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT an."district", ', ' ORDER BY an."district") AS districts
FROM name_counts nc
JOIN admin_names an ON an."first_name" = nc."first_name"
GROUP BY nc."first_name", nc.cnt
ORDER BY nc.cnt DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH school_totals AS (

        s."sname",
        s."dname",
        s."cname",

WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        s."school",
        s."closeddate"
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
      AND s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."closeddate" <> ''
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs."county",
        COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT cc."county"
    FROM county_counts cc
    ORDER BY cc.closed_count DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    cs."county",
    cs."school",
    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc
  ON cs."county" = tc."county"
ORDER BY cs."school";

WITH oldest_mythic AS (
    SELECT
        c."uuid",
        c."name",
        c."originalreleasedate",
        c."rarity"
    FROM "cards" c
    WHERE LOWER(c."rarity") = 'mythic'
      AND c."originalreleasedate" IS NOT NULL
      AND c."originalreleasedate" <> ''
    ORDER BY
        
        CASE
            WHEN c."originalreleasedate" ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'
                THEN c."originalreleasedate"::date
            ELSE NULL
        END ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    om."name"                AS card_name,
    om."originalreleasedate" AS release_date,
    om."rarity"              AS rarity,
    l."format"               AS legal_format,
    l."status"               AS legality_status
FROM oldest_mythic om
LEFT JOIN "legalities" l
       ON l."uuid" = om."uuid"
      AND LOWER(l."status") = 'legal'
ORDER BY l."format";
